analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains stuck in the mid-30s at 37.4, failing to break out of oversold territory. MACD histogram slightly worsened from -0.0020 to -0.0022, maintaining a bearish convergence. ADX at 21.1 indicates low trend strength, making directional calls difficult. Volume ratio at 0.69 suggests subdued activity. Current price $1.25 aligns with SMA5 but is below SMA20 ($1.29) and EMA50 ($1.34). 52-week position at 16.5% is low, but no clear buy signal is present.
